R2-01.why: 1vN 'escape the adult' is a proven Roblox format (Granny, Flee the Facility) and the house-party theme reads instantly to kids and teens. The closest same-theme rival (Clean the House, ~6K peak) is PvE, so the slot is open. The Report Card and the snitch mechanic make clips that spread through YouTube and TikTok creators. The Parent is watched every round, so Parent costumes are the best visible-purchase surface in the set, and the Host House rule is a giftable social purchase. Modular room kits keep monthly house drops affordable. It should be Kids/Select-friendly, needs no chat, and fits ~5-minute mobile sessions.
R2-01.fix: Asymmetric 1vN needs 4-8 humans per server to be fun, and bots playing the Parent kill the fantasy. Below a few hundred CCU, servers feel empty and a cold-start game under the 28-day algorithm never escapes. Budget for launch creators, run private-server and friend-invite incentives, and build a Parent bot that is genuinely good before launch.

R2-02.why: The 'X Together' co-op wave is real: Fart Together hit 13M+ visits even as a crude copy. Co-play is the core of the design, so every session is a friend invite, and that is exactly what discovery rewards. The Captain rule is an elegant, visible, giftable monetization hook, and new vehicles every two weeks are cheap content. But Boat Together (~8.2M visits) already occupies the exact niche. Novelty party games show strong day-1 retention and weak day-8-28 retention.
R2-02.fix: Timing and saturation. By Mar 2027 the 'Together' fad will be four months older and full of clones, and Roblox demotes look-alikes. If the ranked daily seed and the vehicle collection don't hold players past week 2, this spikes and dies. Ship a lean version faster (~10 weeks) or lean harder on the meta.

R2-03.why: Red-light-green-light and hide-in-plain-sight both appeal to kids broadly, and Worst Class Ever shows the 'prank behind authority's back' fantasy is hot. Disguise packs that spawn matching NPCs are one of the smartest monetization ideas in the set: buyers gain fun, not unfairness. Museum wings are reusable content. But the lane is crowded (Be NPC or Die, DISGUISE, In Plain Sight, Prank the Teacher), so the positioning is incremental, not new.
R2-03.fix: Too little differentiation in a crowded hide-in-plain-sight lane. Unless the freeze-in-the-beam moment is visibly different in thumbnails and clips, discovery will treat it as another Be-NPC clone. Make the prank and reel content the hero of the marketing, not the hiding.

R2-04.why: Novel and genuinely touch-native, which is good for a 55-80% mobile audience, and fusion discovery is a natural thing for creators to show off. But tower defence with gesture input has no proven Roblox demand (the nearest comparable, Draw Spells Magic Arena, has ~615 CCU). There is no avatar movement, which weakens the social, hanging-out feel Roblox players expect. Ink-trail cosmetics are weak spend drivers next to avatar-visible items. Roguelite relic content is moderately costly to keep fresh.
R2-04.fix: Unproven demand plus execution risk on gesture recognition. If casting feels unreliable on low-end phones, players churn in the first session and the 28-day signal never forms. Prototype gesture accuracy on cheap Android devices before committing.

R2-05.why: Social deduction has a real audience (Among-Us-likes, MM2), but a deduction game without chat is fighting the age-gated chat reality. Voting meetings driven by icon evidence boards are weak for the persuasion fun that makes the genre. A 4-8 player requirement plus the cognitive load of inspecting tells narrows the audience. Monetization surfaces (museum cases, calling cards) are niche, and adaptive NPC forgers are expensive live-ops.
R2-05.fix: Deduction without chat. Most of the under-16 audience can't argue or bluff, so the social core collapses into guessing. It needs either a convincingly fun no-chat accusation mechanic or an acceptance that it is a 13+ product with a much smaller pool.

R2-06.why: Anomaly horror is the strongest proven trend in the research (Sell Fries ~112K peak, 7 Days Cat-Sitting, Exit 8 licence, Puzzle the top-growing genre). The data-primitive anomaly system is cheap content and suits chapter-based live-ops. The Watcher/Patroller split forces co-play. But it is the most crowded lane, competing with a licensed IP. Monetization (lobby decor, flashlight skins, revives) is thin, and horror limits Kids reach.
R2-06.fix: Late to a crowded lane with weak monetization. By Mar 2027 anomaly games will be saturated, and the information-asymmetry hook doesn't show up in a thumbnail. Even moderate success earns little per player unless a stronger visible cosmetic layer is added.

R2-07.why: The Content Warning replay is a proven viral hook on Steam, and the replay theatre is clip-friendly. But Roblox already has several small Content-Warning-likes, and ghost-hunting is crowded with declining anchors (Survival -6.7%). The 10 Hz 3D replay is a meaningful technical and moderation surface. Monetization (channel branding, studio decor) is weak, and the content treadmill of ghosts, maps and contracts is expensive for a horror audience that burns through content.
R2-07.fix: A crowded genre with weak monetization. The replay novelty fades after a few sessions, and nothing in the meta holds players to day 28. Without a breakout creator moment it lands in the long tail below 1K CCU.

R2-08.why: A charming co-op premise with little direct Roblox competition. The handling rules give it variety, and two-player linked carries create laugh moments. But the 'deliver a fragile thing' fantasy is less instantly clickable than escaping, hiding or collecting. Monetization surfaces (parcel wraps, uniforms, HQ decor) are low-visibility, and procedural houses help content cost but not the reason to come back.
R2-08.fix: Weak hook and weak spend. Without a collection or social-status layer, it is a fun two-week co-op game with poor 28-day retention and low revenue per player. Add a compelling long-term collection, such as the rare-parcel log tied to visible showcase rewards.

R2-09.why: Creature collection is the biggest-spending genre on Roblox, and breeding with visible mutations is a strong day-8-28 retention loop. Cross-breeding with friends adds co-play. Auto-battlers with short matches suit mobile, and the 150-mutation log drives long-term chasing. But the pet-sim and Units/Merge competition is heavy. The no-random-sales constraint caps upside against rival pet games that monetize hatching. Combat balance and economy live-ops are the most expensive in the set, and the scope is large for 2-5 devs in 3-4 months.
R2-09.fix: Scope and live-ops cost. A creature economy plus an auto-battler balance plus breeding is three systems that each need constant tuning, and a broken meta or inflating economy kills retention. It also leans on the U13 spend audience Roblox is deliberately de-prioritising. Cut to a minimal battle loop and validate breeding retention first.

R2-10.why: No direct Roblox competition, and BOMBANANA's demo shows interest on Steam. But a game that requires two people is the narrowest audience model on a platform where many players arrive solo, and bots can't replicate the fun of communication. Puzzle co-op has low replay once modules are learned (seasonal rulebook rotation helps only partly). Device-skin and sticker monetization is weak.
R2-10.fix: The audience floor is two coordinated friends per session. Solo arrivals bounce, and discovery's co-play reward doesn't help if random matching produces silent strangers. Retention past the first week is doubtful.

R2-11.why: Overcooked-style crisis co-op is fun and clip-friendly, the Captain-rule liveries are a decent social purchase, and new vehicles are a clear content cadence. But Land or Die!, Survive the Plane Crash and Backseat Rally already occupy the vehicle-crisis space. The fantasy is generic, and Overcooked-likes struggle with random-player coordination and long-term goals.
R2-11.fix: Generic positioning in an occupied niche. With random players, the chaos is frustration rather than comedy, and the meta (vehicles, routes, rank) is too shallow to carry 28-day retention. Find a sharper hook or a collection layer.

R2-12.why: The best combination of broad, evergreen appeal and a monetizable retention meta. Firefighting and animal rescue is wholesome and suits Kids/Select, which avoids the policy and moderation risk hanging over horror and crude humour. The visitable sanctuary taps Pet-Sim collection psychology without selling randomness. Sanctuary decor and critter accessories scale like pet/tycoon cosmetics. It plays well solo or with 1-4 players, so the audience floor is low. Modular buildings and seasonal critters are cheap live-ops, and there is no known direct competitor combining procedural co-op rescue with collection.
R2-12.fix: The clip-worthy 'wow' is weaker than the party or prank concepts, so organic discovery is slower. It also skews toward young children, the segment where Roblox has cut impressions for spend-heavy games. Make sure sanctuary visits and the two-person rescues produce shareable moments, and keep spend clearly cosmetic so the algorithm treats it as retentive, not cash-grabby.

overall_notes: Skeptical baseline: Roblox DAU is down 9% from a year earlier, discovery now rewards 28-day retention and co-play over short-term spend, and Roblox is pulling impressions from cash-grabby games aimed at young children. The investable concepts pair a proven, instantly readable Roblox fantasy with a durable visible-cosmetic or collection loop and a low player-count floor. R2-01 (viral 1vN, best visible-purchase surface) and R2-12 (evergreen, kid-safe, collection retention, solo-viable) lead at 7. R2-02, R2-03 and R2-09 are credible but carry fad-timing, lane-crowding and scope risk respectively. The anomaly, ghost and deduction concepts sit in crowded or chat-dependent lanes with thin monetization. No concept reaches 8: none has both a clearly open lane and a proven retention-plus-monetization loop, and every round-based multiplayer concept faces the cold-start problem that new games have under the 28-day signal. Budget for creator seeding and friend invites regardless of pick.
